C2PA public test files corpus

The unchanged fixture samples in this directory are from the C2PA public test files corpus, published under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Source repository: https://github.com/c2pa-org/public-testfiles
Corpus page: https://spec.c2pa.org/public-testfiles/
License legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode

The corpus repository and its contributors are the source attribution. Individual sample copyright holders are not identified in the fixture source listing. The application embeds the bytes unchanged for local test use; `SOURCES.json` records exact source URLs and SHA-256 digests.
